verified_facts.text: Savanna Lodge is set within the Sabi Sand Nature Reserve, part of the greater Kruger National Park Conservancy.
verified_facts.excerpt: set within the internationally famous Sabi Sand Nature Reserve, part of the greater Kruger National Park Conservancy

verified_facts.text: Savanna is located in the western Sabi Sand and traverses 10,000 hectares of varied terrain, from open savannah grasslands to riverine bush.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savanna's prime location in the western Sabi Sand allows us to traverse 10 000 hectares of varied terrain, from open savannah grasslands to lush riverine bush

verified_facts.text: Savanna is a privately owned lodge.
Most of the suites have canvas-topped roofs that blend classic safari style with colonial-era elegance.
verified_facts.excerpt: seven of which feature graceful canvas-topped roofs that blend the romance of a classic safari with the elegance of a bygone colonial era

verified_facts.text: Each suite opens onto a private patio with a heated plunge pool, an outdoor shower and views of the bush.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite opens onto a private patio with a heated plunge pool, outdoor shower, and uninterrupted views of the bush.

verified_facts.text: The suites overlook waterholes and the savannah beyond, each set into the indigenous foliage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking waterholes and the Savannah beyond, each suite is purposefully nestled into the indigenous foliage

verified_facts.text: The thatched Savanna Suite has two en-suite bedrooms connected by a lounge and a covered patio, with exclusive access to a private vehicle and guide when booked as a complete package.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring two beautifully appointed en-suite bedrooms connected by an elegant lounge and generous covered patio. Enjoy exclusive access to a private vehicle, guide, and lounge amenities when the suite is booked as a complete package

verified_facts.text: Guests enjoy two game drives per day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests will enjoy two game drives per day.

verified_facts.text: Sightings may include the Big Five, cheetah, wild dog, hippo, crocodile, plains game and more than 400 bird species.
verified_facts.excerpt: sightings may include the Big Five, cheetah, wild dog, hippo, crocodile, an abundance of plains game, and more than 400 bird species

verified_facts.text: The custom-designed safari vehicles seat up to six guests and have individually heated bucket seats.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Custom designed safari vehicles that seat up to six guests.

- Large, cushioned bucket seats that can be heated individually.

verified_facts.text: The main pool looks over gardens and a floodlit waterhole.
verified_facts.excerpt: relaxing at the main pool with views over lush gardens and a floodlit waterhole

verified_facts.text: The loft offers chess and a bird's-eye view of the waterhole, and the adjoining library has facilities to transfer and back up safari photographs.
verified_facts.excerpt: A cosy loft for a quiet game of chess and a bird's-eye view of the waterhole. The adjoining library offers Wi-Fi and facilities to transfer and back up your safari photographs.

verified_facts.text: There is a fully equipped gym, and in-suite massages are offered.
verified_facts.excerpt: Work out in the fully equipped gym with the bush on your doorstep, or enjoy an exquisite in-suite massage

verified_facts.text: Children of all ages are welcome when booking the Savanna Suite; children under 8 are not permitted in the main lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children of all ages are welcome when booking the Savanna Suite. For the main lodge, no children under the age of 8 are permitted.

verified_facts.text: Young guests have a dedicated Bushbabies programme, from discovering animal tracks to bush crafts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our young guests enjoy a dedicated programme of fun and learning – from discovering animal tracks to creative bush crafts

verified_facts.text: Rates include two game drives per day, all meals, teas and coffees, and house drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Two game drives per day

- All meals, teas and coffees

- Drinks (house wines, local brand spirits, beers, and soft drinks)

verified_facts.text: Guests are welcome to visit the community and conservation projects supported by the Savanna Trust.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are welcome to visit these projects during their stay to see first-hand the impact of their support.

verified_facts.text: General manager and guide Neil Whyte was born and brought up in Kruger National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Neil Whyte was born and brought up in Kruger National Park

verified_facts.text: Nearby dams draw elephants daily in the dry winter months.
verified_facts.excerpt: the nearby dams that draw elephants daily in the dry winter months
